title: Naturality of the explicit native one-K-flat model
statement: For the explicit native model [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-model], every map P to P-prime between native K-flat complexes and every map Q to Q-prime between arbitrary native complexes gives the commuting representative square: the native derived tensor map of (Q(g),Q(f)) followed by the model on (P-prime,Q-prime) equals the model on (P,Q) followed by Q(totalMap(f,g)). The monoidal structure is exactly nativeWeilRingedMonoidal b SB.

source.place: Native tensor model, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YS, 06YU, 0FPT

proof.text: Prove generic mapped-product, inverse-square and four-square identities. Apply the faithful native derived equivalence to the claimed square. Counit naturality, mapped factor naturality, the proved middle-model naturality and inverse total-factor naturality supply its four squares. The generic composition identity completes the proof. Keep Functor.mapDerivedCategory locally irreducible during elaboration, without exporting any attribute.

theorem nativeWeilRingedTensorModel_naturality
    (P Q P' Q' : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ)
    (hP : NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X T P) (hP' : NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X T P')
    (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q') :
    (@MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ (nativeWeilRingedMonoidal b SB)).map
        (X := (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
        (Y := (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q', DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'))
        (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map g) (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)) ≫
        (nativeWeilRingedTensorModel b T adj A SB TB βB cB P' Q' hP').hom =
      (nativeWeilRingedTensorModel b T adj A SB TB βB cB P Q hP).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g T (.up ℤ))
